select a.FINPROD_ID finprodId, a.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, a.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, a.CCY ccy, b.TYPE_6 futuresType, c.DELIVERY_METHOD deliveryMethod, c.LAST_SETTLE_DATE lastSettleDate, c.LAST_TRADE_DATE lastTradeDate, c.FUTURES_CONTRACT_ID futuresContractId, c.CONTRACT_MULTIPLIER contractMultiplier, a.REMARK remark from FIN_PRODUCT a , FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE b , FIN_PRODUCT_ADD c where 1=1 and a.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID and a.FINPROD_ID = c.FINPROD_ID and a.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F36,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select a.FINPROD_ID finprodId, a.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, a.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, a.CCY ccy, b.TYPE_6 futuresType, c.DELIVERY_METHOD deliveryMethod, c.LAST_SETTLE_DATE lastSettleDate, c.LAST_TRADE_DATE lastTradeDate, c.FUTURES_CONTRACT_ID futuresContractId ,a.REMARK remark from FIN_PRODUCT a , FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE b , FIN_PRODUCT_ADD c where 1=1 and a.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID and a.FINPROD_ID = c.FINPROD_ID and a.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F36,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select FINPROD_ID as hidCode, FINPROD_MARKET_ID as code , FINPROD_NAME as shortName from FIN_PRODUCT where 1=1 and FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F36,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and (FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{finProdMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) OR FINPROD_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{finProdMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')))

select a.FINPROD_ID finprodId, a.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, a.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, a.CCY ccy, b.TYPE_6 futuresType, c.DELIVERY_METHOD deliveryMethod, c.LAST_SETTLE_DATE lastSettleDate, c.LAST_TRADE_DATE lastTradeDate, c.FUTURES_CONTRACT_ID futuresContractId ,a.REMARK remark from FIN_PRODUCT a, FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE b , FIN_PRODUCT_ADD c where 1=1 and a.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID and a.FINPROD_ID = c.FINPROD_ID and a.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F36,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and c.LAST_TRADE_DATE >= #{cDate}
